scope: 12 fixed film clips only, original-zone diagnostics plus installed controls

definitions.primaryGoodConservative: control > -.066 exceeds every current urgency threshold; abs stored phi<.55; keeper up with xi inside actual posture-scaled support radius proves availability1. Does not certify a correct single-player fit or safe release.
definitions.helperVeto: At least one helper has current dot(keeper contact axis, helper-to-defender) <.25. This is an upper bound on current helperSupport; fatigue and establishment only reduce it.
definitions.backer: Actual rounded replay frame, not consumed vision. Failed original reads do not consume LB images.
definitions.nativeUnits: force kg*yd/s^2, impulse kg*yd/s. Delivered arm impulse player-wide; live paired hands are independent proof of load.
